newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in after-hours trade on Wednesday, as the stronger yen against the dollar stimulated moderate profit-taking in distant months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen firmer than the day's close. Most-active benchmark August was down 0.2 yen at 152.5 yen. Volume during the day was 6,185 lots.

During the day, prices edged up amid a feeling that prices were too low after recent losses. "The market lacked fresh incentives to push up prices. Prices could move within the current ranges for the near-term," one trader said.
